verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes an MCP server and an 'Avi Agent' with natural-language-friendly tools (e.g., AI tax code recommendations, conversational queries, example prompts like 'Calculate tax for a $100 sale...'), which supports natural-language operation for AI agents. However, this is mediated through MCP/agent tooling rather than a native NL interface in the core product, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world reliability of these NL commands. missing for 10: independent corroboration of NL command accuracy, broader coverage of natural-language support outside MCP/Avi Agent context, first-party detail on the full range of NL capabilities beyond a few examples.
